AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Special Event Application for Palos Verdes High School's Annual "Remember The Tritons Walk"
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application allowing Palos Verdes High School's annual "Remember the Tritons Walk" to take place in Palos Verdes Estates on February 22, 2020, and allow the posting of banners promoting the event.

Ordinance No. O20-743 Amending Chapter 8.56 (Smoking Prohibited) and Section 18.12.030 (Prohibited Uses) of Chapter 18.12 (C Zone) of the City's Municipal Code Regulating Electronic Cigarettes, Vaporizers, Pods, and Liquids Used to Inhale and Substance
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council introduce upon first reading Ordinance No. O19-743 amending Chapter 8.56 (Smoking Prohibited) and Section 18.12.030 (Prohibited Uses) of Chapter 18.12 (C Zone) of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code regulating electronic cigarettes, vaporizers, pods, and liquids used to inhale any substance.
Staff Report

8.
Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the Police Ad Hoc Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees, discuss the status of their work, and provide any direction Council deems appropriate.
Staff Report

9.
Resolution R20-02, Amending the Management and Administration Group to Adjust the Finance Director Compensation
Recommendation: It is recommended that Council approve Resolution R20-02 adjusting the Finance Director salary range.
Staff Report
10.
Encroachment Abatement Strategy
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council:Review and provide input on Resolution No. R19-35 consolidating and updating existing Resolutions R05-32, R12-05, & R14-18; Approve abatement prioritization as described under "2; Abatement Prioritization" of this staff report and the hiring of a Code Enforcement Officer contracted on special project; and Review and provide input on Resolution No. R19-36 establishing administrative fines specifically for violations of PVEMC Chapter 12.04.
Staff Report
11.
Fiscal Year 2019-2020 Mid-Year Operating and Capital Improvement Budget Review and Adoption of Resolution R20-03 Approving Mid-Year Appropriations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the mid-year budget and approve Resolution R20-03 approving mid-year appropriations.
Staff Report
